title: Audits of All of Us program

communications.subject: Freedom of Information Act Request: Audits of All of Us program
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request records relating to the All of Us research program of the National Institute of Health (NIH) from the period September 2, 2023 until the day of this request.
The All of Us Research Program’s website states that the program is subject to external audits by the U.S. Government Accountability Office (GAO). I therefore request the following public records:
- Audit reports of the All of Us program.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not. I understand that some information may be exempt under current law; please provide all non-exempt portions of the documents. 

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Mehdi Chouikha
